# injection_moulding
# Baseline of buildCommodityRules — DO NOT hand-edit.
# Regenerate: npx tsx scripts/snapshot-commodity-rules.ts

### context: full
INJECTION MOULDING COST INPUT RULES:
  wallThicknessMm=3.0 (use OCCT mean wall)
  projectedAreaCm2=768.0 (bbox X×Y÷100)
  cavities: >50g→1; 10–50g→2; <10g→4–8
  mouldCostGBP=41500 (OCCT — use verbatim)
  mouldLife=1000000, runnerWeightKg=netWeightKg×0.15 (cold runner) or 0 (hot runner)

### context: degraded
INJECTION MOULDING COST INPUT RULES:
  wallThicknessMm=2.5 (use OCCT mean wall)
  projectedAreaCm2=? (bbox X×Y÷100)
  cavities: >50g→1; 10–50g→2; <10g→4–8
  mouldCostGBP=1-cav small→20000/medium→50000/large→100000 (OCCT — use verbatim)
  mouldLife=1000000, runnerWeightKg=netWeightKg×0.15 (cold runner) or 0 (hot runner)
